description: This file defines a controller class ApplicantController within the OrangeHRM recruitment module. It handles HTTP requests for applicants' actions such as submitting an application, including file upload, validation, and database interaction. It depends on numerous traits, services, and entity classes for managing candidates, attachments, vacancies, and histories.

classes.name: ApplicantController
classes.description: Controller class handling applicant submissions and related processes within the recruitment module of OrangeHRM.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Main method to process applicant form submissions, handle file uploads, validate inputs, perform database transactions, and redirect accordingly.

methods.name: validateParameters
methods.description: Validates the incoming request parameters and uploaded attachment, checks vacancy status.

methods.name: processTransaction
methods.description: Creates candidate, candidate vacancy, candidate history, and attachment records in the database within a transaction.

methods.name: setApplicant
methods.description: Sets candidate properties from the request data.

methods.name: getValidationDecorator
methods.description: Returns the ValidationDecorator instance for parameter validation.

methods.name: getParamRuleCollection
methods.description: Builds the collection of validation rules for request parameters.

methods.name: setCandidateAttachment
methods.description: Associates uploaded resume data with the candidate attachment entity.
